title: Founding engineer (path to cto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding engineer (path to cto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa engenheira, builder, intensa e extremamente dona pra ser nossa CTO fundadora. A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Founding Engineer: codando todos os dias, polindo os 5 produtos até estado lançável, construindo infra compartilhada e operando produto em produção. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, você assume o papel pleno de CTO: contratação, arquitetura, mentoria, direção técnica, e cada vez menos código diário. Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding Operator, que vamos trazer em paralelo. SNAPSHOT • Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges) • Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO) • Equity: 15% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão) • Bônus por milestone de produto: definidos caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários) • Path to CTO consolidado: Cargo se consolida com 3+ engenheiros sob você e infra em produção com SLA • Perfil: full-stack sênior ou staff, AI-native, customer-obsessed, confortável codando legal-tech, dev-tools, cloud, ERP e agentes no mesmo mês O QUE FAZEMOS A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF. Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente): • Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house • Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs • Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows • ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional) • Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt NOSSA MISSÃO Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois. COMO É O DIA A DIA Você não vai herdar uma engenharia rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem head of eng, QA dedicado, Dev Ops. Tem o Pablo (founder, também codador), o Founding Operator (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos com graus diferentes de maturidade. A pessoa certa abre issue do produto jurídico às 9h, faz code review do dev pleno às 11h, refatora o RAG do produto de analytics à tarde, sobe deploy do produto de cloud à noite, e no dia seguinte abre PR de uma abstração compartilhada que vai servir o próximo micro-app. NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ: • Espera receber arquitetura desenhada e sprint planejado. Aqui você É o arquiteto e o planner • Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, gatilhos e milestones • Não codifica em produção há mais de 6 meses. A vaga é hands-on do dia 1 • Tem ego de cargo. Você vai escrever código, fazer deploy, debugar produção, code review, JD, tudo, sozinho, no começo • Não usa IA pra programar (Cursor, Claude, MCP). Aqui IA escreve a maior parte do boilerplate • Tem medo de mexer em múltiplas linguagens/stacks ao mesmo tempo (TS, Python, infra, AI, frontend) • Precisa de processo todo desenhado e backlog todo grooming antes de começar • Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos ship rate, uptime e qualidade semanalmente desde o dia 1 O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Construir e shippar (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses): • Polir os 5 produtos do portfólio até estado lançável (UX, performance, billing, onboarding, observabilidade) • Codar diariamente em produção. Backend, frontend, infra, AI, integrações: você cobre tudo • Estabelecer infra compartilhada (billing, auth, observability, analytics) entre os 5 produtos • Subir o que quebrar, otimizar o que estiver lento, refatorar o que estiver podre Operar e escalar (escopo cresce a partir do mês 3): • Uptime, SLAs, segurança, custo de infra, CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call • Migrar/desmontar o que sobrou de Bubble pra stack code-first quando fizer sentido • Construir abstrações reutilizáveis pro próximo micro-app entrar com fricção mínima Construir time e arquitetura (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6): • Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava • Formar e mentorar o dev pleno e os juniors que já estão no radar • Definir padrões de código, arquitetura, testing, code review, documentação • Trabalhar com o Pablo na visão técnica e com o Founding Operator na priorização de produto STACK Code-first, AI-native, enxuto. Stack atual (e onde queremos chegar): Type Script (Node.js, Nest JS, Next.js, React) · Python (Fast API, NLP, agentes) · Postgre SQL · vector DBs (Weaviate, Chroma DB) · Open AI, Anthropic, Lang Chain · AWS, Vercel, Railway, Docker · Git Hub Actions · Cursor, Claude e MCP pra programar todo dia · Stripe pra billing · Bubble (legacy, vamos migrar/desmontar conforme fizer sentido). Você não precisa ter usado tudo. Precisa ser muito confortável aprendendo rápido e operando full-stack de verdade. QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS • 5+ anos construindo software em produção, com pelo menos 1 produto B2 B sério no histórico • Domínio de Type Script + Python (ou conforto absoluto pra ir e vir entre os dois) • Experiência com banco relacional, APIs, auth, deploy, logs e debugging em produção • Capacidade de ir do problema de negócio ao código sem travar • Uso intenso de IA pra programar, pesquisar, documentar, testar, prototipar e automatizar • Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e cargo de CTO • Capacidade de fazer deep work técnico E pensamento de arquitetura no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois DIFERENCIAIS • Já ter sido founding engineer ou CTO #1 de startup que atingiu PMF • Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-stack) em estúdio, agência ou holding • Experiência com IA em produção: prompts, evals, guardrails, latência, custo, RAG, multi-agent • Experiência com migração/sunset de plataforma low-code (Bubble, Webflow) pra stack code-first • Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 3 a 10 engenheiros • Vontade real de virar CTO de verdade: visão, hiring, board, captação, demissão COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Ship, depois uptime, depois escala. • Ship (semanas 1-12): 5 produtos lançáveis, com infra compartilhada de billing/auth/observability operando • Uptime (mês 4+): SLA em produção, MTTR baixo, incidentes resolvidos com postmortem • Escala (mês 6+): infra suportando 10x usuários sem refatoração; novo micro-app entra com setup de poucos dias • Time: cadência de contratação alinhada com receita; mentoria efetiva do dev pleno e juniors • Ownership: você define meta técnica, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado CULTURA HAMURABI Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e cargo de CTO crescendo com o estúdio. • Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-stack, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária • TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, aqui todos os founding members tem equity). POTENCIAL DE GANHO Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga. Equity: 15% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5 M+ de ARR, múltiplos Saa S B2 B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 3,75 M-7,5 M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15 M+ de ARR), R$ 11 M-22 M. Comp. destravada por receita: • MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano) • MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano) • MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + bônus por milestone Bônus por milestone: definido caso a caso (ship de novo micro-app, atingir SLA-alvo, escalar 10x usuários). COMO APLICAR Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno. E-mail: • Para: • Assunto: Founding CTO - Hamurabi - Aplicacao • Linked In ou Git Hub + texto curto se apresentando Responda também: • Por que você quer ser CTO da Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio? • Qual o sistema mais difícil que você já colocou em produção? Stack, escala, decisões • Como você usa IA hoje no seu trabalho de engenharia? • Olhando os 5 produtos acima, qual você abordaria primeiro tecnicamente, e por quê? • Você topa equity-only no início, com gatilhos de receita destravando comp?

title: Sr ai engineer - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr ai engineer - brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTOA trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it. PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop. We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it. Why this role exists
We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound. If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you. This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them. Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product. What you'll build
The voice-to-action pipeline. Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab. The recommendation engine. Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue. The credit scoring models. Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals. The data flywheel. Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence. US market integrations. Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, Parts Tech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics. What you bring
3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production. Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways. NLP or voice experience. You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments. Full-stack ML instincts. You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team. Builder mentality. You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter. Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred. You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries. Requirements
Timezone: Must be available during US/Lat Am business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async. Commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%. Travel: Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that. What makes this different
At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day. You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality. And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Contador
description:

O profissional atuará na área de Contabilidade com foco nas atividades operacionais, sendo responsável por assegurar a precisão e a conformidade dos registros financeiros da empresa. As principais atividades incluem a elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras, como balanço patrimonial e demonstração de resultados. O contador realizará lançamentos contábeis no sistema, garantindo que todas as operações financeiras sejam registradas de maneira correta e no prazo estipulado. Além disso, o profissional deverá conciliar contas contábeis, verificar e ajustar divergências, e elaborar relatórios gerenciais que auxiliem na tomada de decisões. O contador também será responsável pela apuração de tributos, como Imposto de Renda, PIS/COFINS e ICMS, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e contribuindo para a minimização de riscos tributários. Outra atividade importante será a organização e a manutenção de documentos contábeis, garantindo que todos os arquivos estejam completos e devidamente arquivados para facilitar auditorias e fiscalizações. O profissional poderá interagir com a equipe de tesouraria para gerenciar fluxo de caixa e realizar previsões financeiras. Além disso, será necessário acompanhar alterações na legislação contábil e tributária, promovendo a atualização dos procedimentos internos para adequação às novas normas. O contador deverá ainda prestar suporte em análises de custos e orçamentos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional da empresa. A comunicação eficaz com outras áreas será essencial para coletar informações necessárias e implementar melhorias no processo contábil. O contador atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, lidando com prazos e demandas variadas, sendo fundamental a capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes. Espera-se que o profissional demonstre proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria nos processos contábeis e financeiros da empresa.Cargo: ContadorTipo de Contrato: Prestador de serviço (PJ)Área profissional: ContabilidadeCarga-horária: Número de vagas: 1Requisitos: O profissional que se candidatar à vaga de Contador deve possuir uma sólida formação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Contabilidade (CRC). É crucial ter experiência prática nas rotinas contábeis, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrações financeiras, conciliação bancária, apuração de impostos e fechamento contábil mensal. O candidato deve ser capaz de interpretar e aplicar normativas contábeis e tributárias vigentes, garantindo a conformidade legal das operações da empresa.Além disso, é necessário ter conhecimentos em ferramentas de gestão contábil e financeira, como sistemas ERP, e domínio em pacote Office, especialmente Excel, para a manipulação e análise de dados. A experiência prévia em escritórios de contabilidade ou em setores financeiros de empresas de diferentes portes é um diferencial importante.O contador deve demonstrar habilidade em trabalho em equipe, boa comunicação e organização para lidar com prazos e demandas variadas. É desejável um perfil proativo, com capacidade para identificar melhorias nos processos contábeis e sugerir soluções eficientes. A atenção aos detalhes e a responsabilidade na execução das tarefas são características essenciais para assegurar a precisão das informações contábeis.Por fim, o candidato deve estar disposto a se manter atualizado sobre as mudanças na legislação e nas práticas contábeis, buscando constantemente o aprimoramento profissional por meio de cursos, workshops e outras formas de educação continuada. A vaga requer interesse em atuar operacionalmente, com foco em resultados e qualidade das informações.

title: Analista de planejamento de matéria-prima iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de planejamento de matéria-prima iii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga O time de Produtos e Suprimentos é responsável por toda a cadeia dos produtos do Grupo Caffeine Army - Supercoffee, Morning Shot, Koala e Whey e Creatina (Labs), desde o planejamento de demandas, planejamento e controle da produção e gerenciamento de estoque, garantido o suprimento para a nossa comunidade de milhões de pessoas. Nosso foco é fazer a engrenagem funcionar de forma imparável, da inovação do produto a gestão eficiente de toda a sua cadeia. Buscamos uma pessoa que queira evoluir 1% a cada dia  e crescer junto com a nossa empresa e que tenha espírito de dono , responsabilidade e muita proatividade. Somos empreendedores. Sonhamos alto, somos ousados, acreditamos na nossa capacidade, nos baseando na premissa de que juntos somos mais fortes  e com a colaboração chegamos mais longe. Trabalhamos todos os dias para cumprir com nosso propósito com muito esforço, dedicação, motivação e foco no cliente . Se você se considera imparável  e se identifica com a oportunidade e nossa cultura, então essa vaga é para você!  Desdobrar a demanda de matérias-primas por marca, SKU e industrializador, em conjunto com o PCP, garantindo aderência ao plano de produção aprovado. Construir e manter o planejamento tático de MP, considerando volumes produtivos, mix, lead times, restrições operacionais e janelas de fabricação. Definir, revisar e monitorar parâmetros de abastecimento (ponto de pedido, estoque de segurança, mínimos, máximos e coberturas), garantindo equilíbrio entre disponibilidade e capital empregado. Avaliar a aderência entre consumo real, estoque disponível e plano produtivo, propondo ajustes estruturados sempre que necessário. Atuar preventivamente sobre riscos de ruptura, excesso ou vencimento de matéria-prima. Consolidar o plano de compras de MP, estruturando volumes, prazos e priorizações para execução pelo time de compras. Atuar como interface entre PCP, Planejamento e Compras, garantindo fluidez entre plano produtivo e abastecimento. Apoiar a evolução dos processos e sistemas (MRP, parâmetros e rotinas), contribuindo para maior previsibilidade e acuracidade. Requisitos e qualificações: Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prévia em planejamento de materiais, PCP ou planejamento de demanda. Vivência com MRP e parametrização de estoque (ponto de pedido, estoque de segurança, cobertura). Conhecimento prático em ERP (preferencialmente SAP). Excel intermediário ou avançado para análise de consumo, projeções e simulações. Perfil analítico, estruturado e com boa capacidade de organização e priorização. Diferenciais:  Experiência com planejamento por marca ou múltiplos sites produtivos. Vivência em ambientes industriais ou com fábricas terceiras. Conhecimento em SAP B1. Experiência com S&OP ou ciclos formais de planejamento integrado. Informações adicionais Formato de contratação : CLT; Modelo de Trabalho : Presencial em nosso escritório em Salvador, Bahia; O que oferecemos: Vale-refeição e alimentação (Benefícios Flexíveis CAJU); Vale-transporte (Benefício Flexível CAJU); Plano de Saúde Amil; Plano Odontológico Amil; Gympass; Creditas; Seguro de Vida; Day Off de aniversário; Desconto em produtos Caffeine Army; Retirada mensal de até 3 produtos do Grupo Caffeine Army; Clube de descontos em marcas e instituições parceiras; Bônus anual. Etapas do processo Etapa 1 : Cadastro Etapa 2 : Bate-papo com o Time de Pessoas Etapa 4 : Entrevista com Líder da Área Etapa 5 : Entrevista Cultural Etapa 6 : Proposta & Contratação

Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred. Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams. Mindset: Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team. What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare): Competitive Package: Social Insurance & Accommodation provided + Overseas Allowance. Home Leave: 1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company. Career Growth: This is a developmental role with a clear career path. Top performers will have the opportunity to be promoted to core positions in Project Management or Regional Operations.

title: Ai evaluation engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai evaluation engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About First Ignite First Ignite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at First Ignite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the Open AI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Open AI Evals, Deep Eval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, Lang Graph, Open AI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk management officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including; Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring; Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management. Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English. Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent; unblemished reputation; knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities; technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

• Own daily posting across Tik Tok, IG Reels, You Tube Shorts, X, and more • Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where • Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms • Help shape the voice and presence of brands online • Analyze performance and double down on what works Key Responsibilities1. We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at First Ignite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the Open AI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Open AI Evals, Deep Eval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, Lang Graph, Open AI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your Linked In application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Senior full stack software engineer (latam only)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior full stack software engineer (latam only) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO, Engineering and Product team. About the role Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‐generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes. Tech context You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on: Frontend: Next.js/React, Typescript, Tailwind CSS Backend: Node.js/Type Script with a Postgre SQL core (schema design, auth N,auth Z, performance, transactions, triggers). Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse). Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD. Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO. What you will do Build and ship end‐to‐end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/Type Script backend. Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure auth N/auth Z and strong performance. Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‐driven improvements). Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. Make pragmatic early‐stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar. What you will bring Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and Type Script. Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. Postgre SQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). Integrations experience (third‐party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code. 90-day outcomes In your first 90 days, you will: Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams. Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others. Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement. Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence. Nice to have Experience building voice‐controlled components / speech‐to‐text. Experience interacting with AI models from the web app. How we work Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‐friendly hours. Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership; Product-led culture: engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap. Hiring process Coderpad Challenge (60 min) Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context. Technical deep‐dive & Live testing – discuss systems you've built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia). Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership. References & offer. Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Analista de dataops - tableau (pj)
description:

A BDA Solutions, consultoria especializada em Data & AI, está selecionando um(a) Analista de Dados com especialização em Data Ops e gestão da plataforma Tableau para atuar em projeto estratégico com um de nossos clientes — grande empresa do setor de tecnologia. O profissional irá assumir a gestão e sustentação completa do ambiente Tableau, com foco imediato em um projeto crítico de governança de licenças, evoluindo para a implantação de um framework robusto de qualidade e governança de dados. Modalidade: PJ · Remoto · Tempo integral · Início imediato - TABLEAU Desafio: Conduzir o mapeamento e regularização de um grande volume de licenças compartilhadas, com migração de centenas de usuários para contas nominais. Executar queries SQL no banco de dados do Tableau para extrair um raio-x completo do ambiente, incluindo objetos, conexões, data sources, grupos, permissões e atividade por licença. Documentar todo o processo e fluxos para construção da base de governança. Assegurar a execução correta dos processos ETL/ELT e a disponibilidade do ambiente Tableau. Atender chamados técnicos de concessão de acesso e troubleshooting, apoiando analistas de negócio na resolução de divergências. Administrar permissões no Tableau Server e/ou Cloud conforme políticas internas de segurança e compliance. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Experiência sólida com: Tableau Server e/ou Tableau Cloud. Domínio de SQL, incluindo queries analíticas em bancos de metadados e repositórios internos. Conhecimento em processos ETL/ELT e governança de dados. Familiaridade com integrações entre sistemas corporativos como ERP, CRM e Data Warehouse. Perfil autônomo e investigativo: sabe identificar e resolver problemas sem precisar de acompanhamento constante. Comunicação clara e capacidade de documentação técnica. Uso de ferramentas de IA como Claude ou Chat GPT para acelerar análises e construção de queries. Diferenciais: Experiência com gestão de licenças e estrutura de permissões no Tableau. Conhecimento em Python para automação de tarefas. Experiência com ambientes de nuvem como AWS ou Azure. Se você é o tipo de profissional que toma frente do ambiente, resolve sem esperar ser chamado e usa IA para entregar mais rápido — queremos te conhecer.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk management officer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Key Responsibilities: Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including; Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring; Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management. Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English. Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent; unblemished reputation; knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities; technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Psiquiatra
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Psiquiatra em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. VAGA PARA MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA — ATENDIMENTO ONLINEA Dr Psiq está em expansão e busca médicos(as) psiquiatras comprometidos(as), éticos(as) e responsáveis para atuação em telemedicina, realizando atendimentos psiquiátricos por vídeo em nossa plataforma digital. Buscamos profissionais que compreendam que a psiquiatria vai além da capacidade técnica: valorizamos médicos humanizados, pontuais, comprometidos com seus pacientes e responsáveis com os horários e agendas disponibilizados. Principais atividades Realização de consultas psiquiátricas por vídeo; Avaliação diagnóstica e acompanhamento terapêutico; Elaboração de planos terapêuticos individualizados; Atendimento de adolescentes, adultos e idosos; Evolução em prontuário eletrônico; Emissão e assinatura digital de documentos médicos; Participação no cuidado contínuo e promoção da saúde mental dos pacientes. Requisitos obrigatórios
Graduação em Medicina; CRM ativo e regular; Formação em Psiquiatria através de: Residência Médica com RQE ativo; ou Pós-graduação em Psiquiatria reconhecida; Experiência em atendimento psiquiátrico; Boa comunicação e postura ética; Comprometimento com agendas e horários disponibilizados para atendimento; Possuir certificado digital válido (e-CPF ou equivalente) para inserção na plataforma e assinatura eletrônica de documentos médicos. Documentação obrigatóriaO profissional deverá apresentar: Currículo atualizado; Documento de identificação profissional; CRM ativo; Certidão de regularidade do Conselho Regional de Medicina; Comprovante de quitação da anuidade do CRM; Certidão ético-profissional emitida pelo CRM; Documentação comprobatória da especialização em Psiquiatria; RQE (quando aplicável); Certificado digital válido para utilização na plataforma. Processo seletivoApós análise curricular e documental, o profissional passará por entrevista de habilitação junto à equipe da clínica para avaliação do perfil profissional, disponibilidade e alinhamento com o modelo de atendimento da instituição. Toda a documentação deverá ser encaminhada para o e-mail: Após o envio da documentação, o candidato deverá entrar em contato com o suporte da clínica através do Whats App: informando o interesse na vaga para que seja direcionado(a) ao setor responsável pelo processo de habilitação profissional. Diferenciais Experiência em psiquiatria da infância e adolescência; Conhecimentos em psicofarmacologia e neurociência; Formação complementar em psicoterapia; Fluência em outros idiomas; Disponibilidade para educação continuada. Modelo de atuação
Atendimento 100% online; Plataforma própria de teleconsulta fornecida pela clínica; Flexibilidade de agenda; Remuneração por percentual das consultas realizadas; Parte do valor da consulta destinada à clínica e parte repassada ao profissional. A clínica prioriza profissionais organizados e comprometidos com o funcionamento operacional dos atendimentos. Por isso, é indispensável que o médico: Mantenha disponibilidade regular no Whats App para comunicação com a equipe da clínica; Acompanhe frequentemente a plataforma e o site para verificar consultas agendadas; Responda aos chamados administrativos e assistenciais dentro de prazo razoável; Cumpra impreterivelmente os horários e agendas disponibilizados para atendimento. O que esperamos do profissionalMais do que títulos e currículo, buscamos médicos comprometidos com: Responsabilidade profissional; Pontualidade e organização; Cumprimento rigoroso das agendas; Respeito aos pacientes; Ética e humanização no atendimento; Continuidade e qualidade assistencial.

title: Business development representative - brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business development representative - brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE? We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! Cloud SEK, one of India's most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world's fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we've grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: Cloud SEK's Product Suite: Cloud SEK XVigil constantly maps a customer's digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers' attack surfaces. Cloud SEK's Be Vigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. Cloud SEK's Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones: 2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7 M in Series A funding led by Mass Mutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won Net App Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" Cloud SEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault. About the Role: As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you'll be at the forefront of Cloud SEK's growth. You'll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia's leading cybersecurity company. Requirements: 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a Saa S company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :) We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written. Excellent phone and email etiquette. Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, Hub Spot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you. Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player. You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter. Key Responsibilities: Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (Linked In Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market. Lead qualification: Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile. Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor. Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities. CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system. Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities. Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach. Language: Fluency in English

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Chat GPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Sys Ops Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.) Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) Tik Tok Ads Linked In Ads Trade Desk Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp () is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas.   • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.
