Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Convênio Farmácia

  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:

Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Compliance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.
  • Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience.
  • QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify \"Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment.
  • Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Web3DXB is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.

If you’re passionate about Web3, AI, and investing , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Digital Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).

Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.

  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Na redspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.


Seu papel no time:

  • Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.
  • Gestão do Glossário: Ser a ponte que padroniza os termos de negócio entre diferentes sistemas.
  • Data Quality na veia: Implementar regras de qualidade, monitorar métricas e apoiar o tratamento de inconsistências.
  • Mestria em Dados (MDM): Apoiar a estruturação de fontes autoritativas e dados mestres.
  • Linhagem e Transparência: Garantir a documentação e a rastreabilidade total da informação (da origem ao consumo).
  • Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Chiniese-Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator（Mandarin required））
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chiniese-Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator（Mandarin required）） em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role: We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator to join our international team. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Chinese headquarters and our local operations in Brazil. It is a unique opportunity not only to utilize your language skills but also to grow into a project management or regional operations role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Mandarin Interpretation & Translation: Provide high-quality consecutive interpretation (Mandarin ↔ Brazilian Portuguese) for board meetings, business negotiations, and technical site visits.
  • Document Management: Translate project documents, contracts, and technical specifications from Chinese to Portuguese and vice versa .
  • On-site Coordination: Act as the primary linguistic link between Chinese expatriates and the local Brazilian workforce to ensure cultural alignment and operational efficiency.
  • Operational Support: Assist HR, Finance, and Admin departments in interfacing with local entities using your bilingual skills.
  • Project Growth: Take on project management tasks as your understanding of our Chinese-Brazilian operations deepens.

Qualifications (Mandarin is Essential):

  • Language Proficiency (Mandatory): Native or professional-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese (HSK 4 or equivalent) and Brazilian Portuguese. (English is a plus)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Experience: Proven experience in Chinese-Portuguese interpretation/translation. Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams.
  • Mindset: Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team.

What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare):

  • Competitive Package: Social Insurance &Accommodation provided + Overseas Allowance.
  • Home Leave: 1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company.
  • Holidays & Gifts: Observance of Brazilian statutory holidays + Benefits for birthdays and traditional festivals (gifts, celebrations, etc.).
  • Accommodation: Corporate housing provided.

Career Growth: This is a developmental role with a clear career path. Top performers will have the opportunity to be promoted to core positions in Project Management or Regional Operations .

title: KDB+/Q Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para KDB+/Q Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A nossa paixão coloca-nos no lugar certo.

A CodeWin nasceu da fusão de duas empresas líderes no setor tecnológico: Decode e Sowin . Unimos a nossa paixão, os nossos talentos, conhecimentos e experiências para levar até às nossas pessoas e parceiros as melhores soluções em transformação digital e consultoria. A nossa expertise assenta em Software Development, ERP, CRM, Data Strategy e Digital Experiences.

Queremos contribuir para um mundo melhor e sabemos que isso só é possível equilibrando a evolução tecnológica com o bem-estar das empresas, pessoas e sociedade. Para isso, precisamos das pessoas certas. Para isso, precisamos de ti!


O que precisas para ter o nosso CODE:


  • Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática/Gestão/Economia ou similar;
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional com KDB+ e com a Linguagem Q
  • Experiência profissional com a arquitetura do sistema, funções nativas, e interação com hardwares;
  • Experiência com Linux/Unix
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
  • Fluente em Inglês e Português;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em São Paulo, ou remoto.


O que temos para ser o WIN que te falta:

- Acompanhamento personalizado. Preocupamo-nos com o teu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Queremos proporcionar-te o equilíbrio certo entre a tua vida pessoal e profissional, queremos ver-te evoluir.

- Trabalhamos com um objetivo. Somos flexíveis no horário e oferecemos a possibilidade de trabalho remoto. O importante é cumprires os teus objetivos e sentires-te realizado.

- Investimos na tua carreira. Damos-te acesso a formação certificada, plataformas online e centro de exames Pearson VUE.

- Experiência e destaque no mercado tecnológico. A CodeWin pertence a um grupo multinacional com 24 marcas, mais de 7.000 colaboradores e presença em 14 países.

- Um conjunto de benefícios para o teu dia-a-dia. Seguro de saúde, seguro de vida e acidentes pessoais, um leque de descontos e benefícios, plano de telecomunicações e muito mais.

- Damos importância ao que realmente importa. Disponibilizamos-te consultas gratuitas de medicina geral, nutrição e psicologia.


Queremos marcar pela diferença com as nossas ideias e soluções. Para isso, precisamos de ti e de unir as nossas forças. Aceitas o desafio?


All in the right place



*Na CodeWin, defendemos a igualdade e valorizamos a diversidade. Criamos um ambiente seguro, diversificado, onde as oportunidades são iguais para todos os colaboradores! Não discriminamos com base em idade, etnia, orientação sexual, género, deficiência ou qualquer fator que não seja o mérito. Todas as candidaturas com competências para o cargo são bem-vindas!

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner - Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

description:

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Relatório pra um cliente.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.

O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms

Frontend

Databases

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. title: Senior Mobile Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Mobile Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Mobile Developer


Role Purpose

As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like OpenCV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.

  • Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds

  • State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit

  • Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using GitHub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines

  • Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native JavaScriptTypeScript
  • Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
  • State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
  • Computer Vision: Experience integrating OpenCV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
  • Version Control: Advanced proficiency in GitHub workflows and Gitbased collaboration


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in SwiftObjectiveC iOS or JavaKotlin Android

description:

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.


Competências técnicas


  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos desejáveis


  • Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.


Sobre a UPX


Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.


Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.


Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
